{{Quote|At... at last! One... one... one of the Force! I will... will... tea- teach you! You... you... you will be the new... the new Emperor! You will rein- rein- reinstate me!|The CZ-series secretary/comm droid, to Jaina Solo|<ref name="Chewbacca" />}}
When [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] was a child, '''a malfunctioning [[CZ-series secretary/comm droid]]''' attempted to corrupt her to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Jaina had been playing with her [[Han Solo/Legends|father]] and [[Solo family/Legends|siblings]] in a garden in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]]. She found the droid's hand in a bush, and followed it after it scurried away. The hand led her to a trash chute that opened up to a room full of trashed [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The CZ droid was happy to have finally lured a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]], and expressed his plans to train Jaina to be the new [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and help reinstate him. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] followed Jaina down the chute and exploded out, punching the head off the droid. The droid warned Chewbacca that his body was a switch to a [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct]] sequence. As the timer counted down, the other scrapped droids awoke and attempted to capture Chewbacca. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] barely managed to escape up the trash chute with Jaina in his arms before the chamber exploded.<ref name="Chewbacca" />
